input.preserve: every context key and every supplied field byte; absent differs from zero; missing differs from empty

failure.raw: prior_failure, or copied local_body byte index 7 on admitted success; empty on initialize

copied_body.raw: exactly first nine local_body bytes on success
copied_body.state: Hypothesis; incomplete when admitted but unavailable

refresh.admit: parsed == true and count != 0 and available span >= 9

errors: duplicate object keys at any depth
non-scalar or wrong scalar argument kinds
unknown: unknown operation or absent refresh operation
invariants: outside-domain number only with candidate_domain=false when explicitly specified; none specified here
Unknown sibling fields do not erase valid fields
eBUS MCP and GraphQL parity unchanged
